title: Little Light Bible Stories: Kids Ebook Reader with Illustrations, Coloring Pages, Audio, and PDF Export

requirements.text: Create a “Little Light Bible Stories” ebook experience containing exactly 20 stories starting from Creation, with an in-app reading experience (table of contents + story view) that works without requiring users to download the PDF.

quotes: Create a Bible Stories ebook with the theme Little Light Bible Stories

acceptanceCriteria: The app displays a Table of Contents listing 20 stories in order, starting from Creation.
A user can open a story to read it inside the app.
Each story includes at minimum: title, story text, and a clear story order/index.
Story navigation supports moving to next/previous story.

requirements.text: Provide an ebook export feature that generates one combined, downloadable PDF containing all 20 stories in order, including each story’s illustration and a kid-friendly coloring page.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can click a “Download PDF” action to generate and download a single PDF file containing all 20 stories.
The PDF includes a cover page and then each story with its illustration and a separate coloring page (or clearly separated section) for that story.
PDF generation occurs in the client (no external services required).
If PDF generation fails, the UI shows a readable error message in English and allows retry.

requirements.text: Add automatic audio narration for each story, playable inside the app, with basic playback controls (play/pause, restart, and progress display).
acceptanceCriteria: Each story view includes audio narration playback controls.
Audio playback works for all 20 stories without requiring the user to upload audio files.
If audio is not supported by the browser/device, the UI shows a clear English fallback message.

requirements.text: Include automatically generated illustrated images for each story and kid-friendly coloring pages (coloring-book style line art) throughout the ebook/app, and store them as static frontend assets.

quotes: please add images for illustration and colour pages for kids

acceptanceCriteria: Each story view displays one illustration image and one coloring page image.
All required images are shipped as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated (not served from the backend).
Coloring pages are black-and-white, high-contrast line art suitable for printing.

requirements.text: Persist the ebook’s story metadata/content in the Motoko backend so the frontend loads the list of stories and their data from the canister (not hardcoded only in the UI).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query methods to fetch the full story list and to fetch a story by its id/slug/index.
Backend returns stable identifiers for stories so links/navigation remain consistent.
The frontend reads stories via the generated actor interface and renders them accordingly.

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive, kid-friendly visual theme for “Little Light Bible Stories” across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling), avoiding blue/purple as primary colors unless required by content.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI uses a consistent design system (colors, type scale, and component styles) across pages.
The theme feels playful and readable for kids/parents (high contrast, large comfortable text sizes).
Primary palette is not blue/purple-dominant.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
No third-party auth providers; only Internet Identity if authentication is later added (not required for this build).
Do not rely on external AI services for generation; automatic audio/illustration behaviors must be implemented without external API calls.
nonGoals: Per-story individual PDF downloads (only one combined PDF is required).
User uploading custom images or audio files.
